【15】1\.    Medical Qigong Purgation: These techniques (also known as "Xie," to drain off or reduce an Excess) are used by the Medical Qigong doctor to treat the patient's Excess syndromes and to detoxify the body of pathogenic Qi. The "lower aspect" of classical Chinese medicine governs the treatment of the patient's illness, and corresponds to Earth. It involves purging pathogenic influences and dispersing stagnations in order to cure the patient's illness. This allows the patient the ability to remove Excess Qi from his or her organs and tissues.

【16】2\.    Medical Qigong Tonification: These techniques (also known as "Bu," to strengthen a Deficiency) are used by the Medical Qigong doctor to treat the patient's Deficient syndromes, and to strengthen and stabilize the organs and organ systems. The "middle aspect" of classical Chinese medicine governs the nourishment of the patient's nature and corresponds to Man. It involves helping the patient prevent illness by tonifying organ energy Deficiencies. This allows the patient the ability to replenish organ energy depletions and tissue emaciation.

【17】3\.    Medical Qigong Regulation: These techniques (also known as "Tiao," to mix, balance, or adjust) are used by the doctor to balance the patient's Yin and Yang energy, and organ Qi. The "highest aspect" of classical Chinese medicine governs the nourishment of the patient's destiny and corresponds to Heaven. It involves regulating the patient's Three Dantians, Taiji Pole, Yin and Yang organs, and energy fields. Regulation techniques promote a balance of

【18】Jing, Qi, and Shen for the optimal development of all the aspects of man: body, mind, emotion, spirit, and energy. Thus, in China, Medical Qigong regulation is said to "nourish the patient's destiny" .

【19】Purgation Techniques

【20】The ancient Chinese believed that the points along the channels allowed the individual's Spirit Qi to flow in and out of the body, unhampered by skin, flesh, muscle or bone. According to the "Laws of Heaven " from the Magical Pivot (Ling Shu), when Evil Qi first invades the body, it stays at the top of the channels, subtly affecting the Spirit's Qi.

【21】During treatment, the Qigong doctor should avoid forcing projected Qi deep into the patient's body without first purging the tissues and channels; too deep a projection can cause the Evil Qi to "follow and enter," sinking it deeper into the patient's body, increasing the disease.

【22】Clinically, when beginning to purge the channels of Evil Qi, the Qigong doctor will begin by dredging the spiritual matrix of the patient's tissues first, then follow with dredging the energetic matrix of the patient's tissues, working his or her way through the various fields of the physical tissues. This type of approach in purgation is accomplished by the Qigong doctor using light wisping movements with his or her palms, as if releasing "small winds to blow away the clouds and clear the blue sky."

【23】By focusing his or her intention on clearing the patient's spiritual and energetic fields, the Qigong doctor is able to effectively stimulate and initiate change within the patient's cellular tissues before tonification begins. The pattern of first purging the spiritual and energetic fields is commonly used in China before the Qigong doctor physically touches his or her patient's body .

【24】The patient's body can be dredged and purged by using two different methods. The first method is the direct removal of pathogens from the patient's tissues and organs. The second method is the indirect purging of the patient's tissues and organs through the channels and points of the patient's body. These two methods serve two different purposes: The Direct Removal of Pathogenic Factors and The Purgation of Channels and Points.

【25】1\.    The Direct Removal of Pathogenic Factors:

【26】This is achieved by extending Qi into the tissues and organs where there are pathogenic factors, and then dredging the Toxic Qi directly out of these locations. This method is used to expel pain due to Excess Heat or Cold. The various techniques used in this type of purging employ stationary Qi-guiding manipulations. The various hand manipulations used for the direct removal of pathogenic factors consists of such techniques as: The Five Thunder Fingers Hand Posture, Shaking and Trembling Hand Posture, Bellows Palm, Vibrating Palm, Dragon's Mouth Palm, Tiger Kneading Palm, and Spiraling Palm .

【27】2\.    The Purgation of Channels and Points: These techniques are used to expel external pathogenic Evils (Wind, Fire, Heat, Dry, Damp, Cold, and environmental toxins) or internal pathogenic Evils (worry, fear, anger, and grief) from the organs and tissues of the body. They are also used to redirect Rebellious Qi (Stomach, Liver, Lungs). The various techniques used in this type of purging employ dynamic-linear Qi-guiding manipulations such as the Pulling, Leading, and Guiding techniques .

【32】Tonification occurs as the doctor exhales while guiding and directing Qi into the channels, points, and the internal organs and tissues of the patient's body. Purgation happens when the doctor inhales while guiding, emitting, and leading the patient's Qi, or pulling the pathogenic Evils out of the patient's body.

【33】During treatment, it is important that the patient cooperate with the doctor by matching (if possible), per the doctor's instruction, his or her breathing rhythm to the doctor's treatment. The patient should assume a proper posture (lying, sitting or standing), relax, and concentrate his or her mind on the location that is being worked on. When the doctor exhales and emits Qi toward the patient, the patient should inhale to absorb the doctor's Qi into the designated location. When the doctor performs purgation, the patient should exhale to release Toxic Qi out of his or her body.

【61】Tonification and Purgation Guidelines

【62】When the Qigong doctor Purges and Tonifies a patient, he or she must remember to adhere to the following Medical Qigong guidelines. Guidelines for the Doctor

【63】When treating the patient, the doctor must always consciously direct and be aware of the movements of each hand:

【64】1\. Generally, the right hand is used for tonification, while the left hand is used for purgation.

【65】Diseases that require purgation are treated by draining Toxic Qi with the left hand. Diseases that require tonification are treated by extending Qi through the right hand.

【66】2\. Clockwise drilling (the palm or extended fingers move in a clockwise direction over an area) is used for tonification and increasing Qi; counterclockwise drilling is used for purgation and decreasing Qi.

【67】Guidelines for the Patient

【68】The patient, (like the Qigong doctor), must be aware of hand movements when practicing Qigong prescriptions. In addition, the patient must be aware of his or her posture, respiration, and mental attitude:

【69】1\.    Turning hands towards the body is used for tonification, while turning the hands away from the body is used for purgation.

【70】2\.    Moving the hands away from the body and upward can regulate the Yang energy, causing it to rise, and tends to tonify. Moving the hands downward pulls the Yang energy down, and tends to purge.

【71】3\.    The eyes are open for purgation; the eyes are closed for tonification. The patient should apply these principles according to the symptoms of the disease.

【72】4\.    Inhalation is used for tonification. When combined with color, the inhalation method becomes a very powerful method of tonification.

【73】5\.    Exhalation is used for purgation. When combined with sound, the exhalation method becomes a very powerful method of purgation. During purgation treatments, patients assume the proper postures, relax, and concentrate their mind on the diseased area while exhaling the pathogenic Qi. This exhalation technique is used not only to promote the removal of toxins, but is also used to enhance the doctor's efficacy in purging the diseased area.

【74】6\.    Audible and Inaudible Sound Projection  can have the function of either Tonification or Purgation. Sounding the silent tone when inhaling can be used for tonification; while exhaling, the audible tone is used for purgation.

【8】**ISSUES AND ADVERSE EVENTS IN CLINICAL RESEARCH WITH CHILDREN**

【9】Psychopharmacologic research in children and adolescents is making steady progress but it is still limited. There is a great disparity between the extent of psychotropic medication use in children and adolescents and the research data supporting its use.

【10】To a great extent， assumptions about pediatric psychopharmacology have been borrowed from adult patients. Although some extrapolations from adults to children are valid， a number of issues pertaining to pediatric pharmacody-namics， pharmacokinesis， and developmental psychopharmacology are spe-cific to childhood and adolescence； these particulars need further elucidation through systematic short- and long-term studies. Pertinent studies with large numbers of patients for extended periods of time are needed. Of late， we have been made aware that data related to negative outcomes and serious side ef-fects are seldom published， which has caused a disproportionate bias toward the purported positive effects of medications.

**Erroneous pharmacological generalizations from adults to children have been made. Examples of a developmental differential response in children|删除0换行|include： (1) anticholinergic desipramine side effects (constipation and dry mouth) are less pronounced in children under 18 years of age than in adults， and (2) contrary to report in adult patients， olan-zapine increases the levels of prolactin in children and adolescents .

【12】The NIMH Collaborative Multisite Multimodal Treatment Study of Chil-dren with ADHD (MTI) demonstrated that the largest source of variance in the AE data， when a drug specific checklist was used， came from the type of informant . This is pertinent to the study of antipsychotic side effects. Lethal adverse reactions may reflect developmental susceptibility of children for catastrophic side effect responses. Since the mid-1990s， there have been at least five serious， though rare， adverse events associated with psychotropic medications in children andadolescents. These include sudden deaths related to desipramine for ADHD (3 children)， four deaths in children taking meth-ylphenidate， clonidine， and other drugs； 25 deaths related to hepatotoxicity， plus four deaths secondary to hemorrhagic pancreatitis in pediatric patients taking valproic acid， and 11 cases ofextreme hepatotoxicity， which resulted in death or liver transplant in individuals being treated with pemoline for ADHD. At the present time it is unknown how many children had fatal outcomes with atypical drugs (ketoacidosis， cardiovascular events， etc.). Of course， it is likely that the number of actual fatalities is larger due to underreporting.

【13】**DEVELOPMENTAL ASPECTS OF PSYCHOTROPIC SIDE EFFECTS**

【14】Adverse events (AE) are developmentally sensitive. Substantial AE data are available for adults， but it is unknown whether AE risks or patterns of risk are similar in children and adolescents. Age and developmental stage can play an important role in determining AE patterns to pharmacological interventions. Thus， Reye's syndrome (secondary to aspirin) and "gray baby syndrome'(due to chloranfenicol) are examples of unique medication reactions in childhood that are not observed in adults. The same is true for fatal arrhythmias secondary to use of desipramine in childhood and the exfoliating dermatitis reaction to lamotrigene in childhood. The polycystic ovarian syndrome risk described with valproate should be included in this category. AE risks may be similar across development for some complaints； however， some risks may be significantly more common in children or adolescents than in adults . Sometimes， it takes many years to recognize the deleterious side effects of a medication. Pemoline was in use for more that 20 years before a rare， unexpected， and serious AE hepatic failure， was discovered .

【52】**ELICITATION OF SIDE EFFECTS**

【53】Unlike tests for efficacy which can pose a single specific research question and then test it， safety monitoring has to use a broad， flexible vigilance method for detecting any safety issues， expected or unexpected， from mild to serious. In determining AE， a sound clinical practice would recommend the following：

【54】**·Children and adolescents themselves should become a primary source of intormation.**

【55】More than one source of information (parents， teachers， and others) is more accurate for detecting and reporting AE.

【56】·Spontaneous， passive reporting or a general unspecific inquiry is un-satisfactory， since patients may either fail to report important AEs or the psychiatrist may fail to make pertinent inquiry of AEs related to the medication in question.

【57】·Monitoring of side effects needs to be systematic and standardized； specific checklists may be useful for this objective .

【58】The extent and severity of AEs in children and adolescents have not re-ceived enough attention in the investigation of psychotropic medications. Most of the published studies on psychotropic pediatric use do not collect or report data on AE in a systematic fashion. The FDA ought to demand AE studies in pediatric populations and develop new systems of vigilance and monitoring of the psychotropics in current use to insure detection of AE trends and to alert practitioners of emerging concerns.

【59】**MOOD STABILIZERS： SIDE EFFECTS**

【60】**Weller， Kloos， Hitchcock， and Weller (2005) question whether lithium and antiepileptic agents are safe for use in children. They also remind physicians that except for lithium， which is only approved for use in children over 12 years of age， none of the other anticonvulsants are approved for use in childhood. The authors stress that the evidence base for the use of mood stabilizers for the treatment of bipolar disorders in children and adolescents is sparse. According to these authors， valproate or lithium should be tried first for the treatment of nonpsychotic pediatric mania， and they consider olanzapine， quetiapine， or risperidone as alternative first-line treatments. The authors think that other anticonvulsants may be justified， when the first-line treatments are unsuccess-ful or tolerance problems emerge (pp. 31-32). The most significant concern with polypharmacy is the increased risk of medication related AEs .**

【61】**Lithium**

【62】**The 2006 PDR contains no Black Boxes for lithium carbonate or its controlled-release forms， Eskalith-CR(pp.1406-1408)or Lithobid. Short-term side effects include gastric irritability， nausea and vomiting， polyuria， and tremor. Small children are prone to reactivate enuresis， or become enuretic for the first time. Gastric irritability is one of the most common causes for lithium discontinu-ation in children.**

【63】**_Teratogenicity_**

【64】**_Uncommon， Predictable， Potentially Serious_**

【65】**Lithiums teratogenic effects are no greater than those in placebo-controlled stud-ies， and lithium is the medication of choice for pregnant bipolar manic patients.**

【66】**_Seizure Potential_**

【67】**_Uncommon， Predictable， Potentially Serious_**

【68】EEG abnormalities were found in nearly two thirds of patients treated with lithium， including background slowing with high-voltage anterior delta activity and a 17% risk of spike discharge. Recent use of lithium may contribute to the association found between EEG abnormalities and bipolar disorder . Among commonly prescribed psychotropics for children and adolescents，lithium and bupropion are the most epileptogenic drugs.

【69】**_Neurotoxicity_**

【70】**_Uncommon， Predictable， Potentially Serious_**

【71】Neurotoxicity， delirium， and encephalopathy have been described with lithium； concomitantECT and neuroleptic medications increase this risk. Neurotoxicity is not necessarily associated with elevated lithium blood levels. It is suggested that patients with high levels of psychosis and anxiety are at a greater risk for neurotoxic reactions. Such reactions may be irreversible and neurological deficits (ataxia， movement disorders， memory problems， and fine motor defi-cits-slowing in performance rate) have been reported after lithium intoxication.

【72】**Tremor affects between 4% and 65% of patients receiving lithium. Tremor may decrease overtime. Severe tremor may indicate toxicity. Interestingly， elimination of caffeine makes the tremor worse because caffeine stimulates renal lithium clearance .**

【73】_Thyroid Problems_

【74】**_Common， Predictable， Remediable_**

【75】Female patients and persons over 50 years of age are more likely to develop hypothyroidism with lithium treatment. In some studies， the rate of hypothy-roidism is about 3.5% for males and about 15% for female， a fourfold gender difference. If the there is history of family hypothyroidism the risk oflithium-induced hypothyroidism is increased. Clinical practice mandates thyroid hormone supplementation if thyrotropin is increased (pp. 555-556).

【76】**_Renal Dysfunction_**

【77】**_Rare， Unpredictable， Feared， and Potentially Very Serious_**

Renal morbidity in lithium treated patients is rare； however，lithium may cause renal tubular damage. Renal concentration ability may get compromised with lithium use， and as a result patients may experience polyuria. 【1】#### 6.3.2.3 Adult T-Cell Leukemia/Lymphoma (ATLL)

【2】ATLL is a T-cell leukemia/lymphoma characterized by atypical cerebriform cells in the blood. However, ATLL is caused by HTLV-1, while Sézary syndrome has no viral association. ATLL also has a very strong geographic predilection for areas of the world where HTLV-1 is endemic, including the Caribbean, Southeast Asia, and sub-Saharan Africa 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 47 \]</u>. While the presence of a positive HTLV-1 titer is supportive of a diagnosis of ATLL, integration of proviral DNA is diagnostic and allows for differentiation from Sézary syndrome. A diagnosis of ATLL cannot be made without HTLV-1 positivity 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 47 \]</u>.

【4】As with ATLL and Sézary syndrome, T-PLL is a mature T-cell leukemia derived from post-thymic alpha/beta T cells 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 48 \]</u>. 【9】#### 6.3.2.5 Hypereosinophilic Syndromes and Malignancies

【10】Peripheral blood eosinophilia is common in Sézary syndrome, which raises concern for a number of malignant and nonmalignant conditions associated with hypereosinophilia. Relevant malignancies include chronic eosinophilic leukemia, acute myelogenous leukemia, B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia, Hodgkin lymphoma, and systemic mastocytosis. Hypereosinophilia can also be seen in parasitic infections, allergic/atopic diseases, and drug hypersensitivity. Primary immunodeficiencies including hyper–IgE syndrome may be considered. Rheumatologic conditions include Churg-Strauss and eosinophilia-myalgia syndromes. Important diagnostic clues include the duration of the eosinophilia, drug exposure, environmental exposure, and concurrent illnesses or systemic symptoms. One key differentiator is that few of these illnesses present with the erythroderma characteristic of Sézary syndrome 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 51 \]</u>.

【11】6.4 Clinical Case
-----------------

【12】Case 6.1

【13】A 32-year-old woman presented with a 3-year history of diffuse erythema and pruritus. She first noticed the development of a rough patch on her inner thigh during her first pregnancy, which over 4–5 months evolved into erythroderma with intractable pruritus. On examination she had diffuse erythroderma, exfoliation, hair loss , onychodystrophy, and palpable inguinal lymphadenopathy. She had received partial treatment at another institution.

【14】Flow cytometry of peripheral blood revealed the presence of 555/µL atypical T cells and a CD4:CD8 ratio of 6.9:1. The peripheral smear showed numerous small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm with convoluted, indented nuclei and coarse chromatin. She was diagnosed with partially treated Sézary syndrome. A lymph node biopsy showed dermatopathic changes.

【15】She underwent a course of single-agent targeted therapy and total skin electron beam treatment for residual skin plaques prior to an allogeneic matched hematopoietic stem cell transplant, complicated by mild graft-versus-host disease.

【16】Commentary

【17】This patient presented with the classic triad of erythema, lymphadenopathy, and atypical cells in the blood. She also demonstrated other common findings, including hair loss and onychodystrophy. Because she had previously been partially treated, her flow cytometry did not formally meet criteria for a diagnosis of Sézary syndrome, with a CD4:CD8 ratio of only 6.9:1 and just 555/µL atypical cells. As a result of refractory disease despite multiple systemic treatments, she ultimately underwent a hematopoietic stem-cell transplant, the only definitive therapy available for this disease.

【18】Case 6.2

【19】A 62-year-old woman presented with a 2-year history of diffuse pruritus refractory to treatment and a new peripheral eosinophilia. The itch had been intensifying over the last year and was accompanied by erythematous patches on her skin and the development of thickened, loose skin over her joints, back, abdomen, and thighs . Her axillae and groin were uninvolved, and she had no nail changes. She reported intermittent chills and fever for the last year.

【20】A peripheral blood smear revealed the presence of numerous lymphoid cells with cerebriform nuclei . A skin biopsy demonstrated a perivascular infiltrate of atypical CD4+ lymphoid cells  and a normal tissue elastin stain. Peripheral blood flow cytometry revealed a large population of atypical CD3+ cells, a CD4:CD8 ratio of 15:1, and loss of CD7 and CD26 on 85 % of T cells . The patient was diagnosed with Sézary syndrome.

【21】Although she underwent treatment with extracorporeal photophoresis, her condition continued to deteriorate. She developed severe onychodystrophy  and thickening and fissuring of the skin complicated by secondary infection .

【22】Commentary

【23】This patient presented with the classic triad of Sézary syndrome: erythroderma, lymphadenopathy, and atypical cells in the blood (a CD4:8 ratio of 15:1 and loss of CD7 and CD26 on 85 % of cells). Her complete blood count also demonstrated a marked eosinophilia, a not uncommon finding in patients with Sézary syndrome. She was treated with extracorporeal photopheresis, a therapy that has shown significant success in treating (but not curing) Sézary syndrome. This case also highlights the point that patients with Sézary syndrome are at risk for frequent skin infections because of their immune-compromised state and damage to the skin, which in some cases can lead to sepsis and even death.

【1】#### 6.3.2.3 Adult T-Cell Leukemia/Lymphoma (ATLL)

【2】ATLL is a T-cell leukemia/lymphoma characterized by atypical cerebriform cells in the blood. However, ATLL is caused by HTLV-1, while Sézary syndrome has no viral association. ATLL also has a very strong geographic predilection for areas of the world where HTLV-1 is endemic, including the Caribbean, Southeast Asia, and sub-Saharan Africa 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 47 \]</u>. While the presence of a positive HTLV-1 titer is supportive of a diagnosis of ATLL, integration of proviral DNA is diagnostic and allows for differentiation from Sézary syndrome. A diagnosis of ATLL cannot be made without HTLV-1 positivity 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 47 \]</u>.

【3】#### 6.3.2.4 T-Cell Prolymphocytic Leukemia (T-PLL)

【4】As with ATLL and Sézary syndrome, T-PLL is a mature T-cell leukemia derived from post-thymic alpha/beta T cells 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 48 \]</u>. T-PLL, a disease of the elderly, is the most common mature T-cell leukemia 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 48 \]</u>. T-PLL typically presents with marked leukocytosis and hepatosplenomegaly 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 48 \]</u>. Skin involvement is common, occurring in 26 % of patients and may include maculopapular lesions, bruising, or focal erythroderma that becomes generalized over a period of months. However, in contrast to Sézary syndrome, generalized erythroderma is rare in T-PLL 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 48 , 49 \]</u>. These diseases also have very different time courses. Whereas patients with T-PLL experience a short prodrome of systemic symptoms lasting a median of 2 months prior to diagnosis, the prodrome of Sézary syndrome lasts 24 months on average 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 49 \]</u>. The circulating leukemic cells of T-PLL may present with cerebriform morphology indistinguishable from that of Sézary syndrome 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 49 \]</u>. These diseases can often be differentiated on peripheral blood flow cytometry. The cells of Sézary syndrome are typically CD7− CD26−, whereas those of T-PLL are usually CD7+ CD26+ 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 48 , 49 \]</u> . Chromosomal rearrangement of TCL-1 occurs in T-PLL and may help to differentative from Sézary syndrome 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 50 \]</u>.

【20】A peripheral blood smear revealed the presence of numerous lymphoid cells with cerebriform nuclei . A skin biopsy demonstrated a perivascular infiltrate of atypical CD4+ lymphoid cells  and a normal tissue elastin stain. Peripheral blood flow cytometry revealed a large population of atypical CD3+ cells, a CD4:CD8 ratio of 15:1, and loss of CD7 and CD26 on 85 % of T cells . The patient was diagnosed with Sézary syndrome.

【21】Although she underwent treatment with extracorporeal photophoresis, her condition continued to deteriorate. She developed severe onychodystrophy  and thickening and fissuring of the skin complicated by secondary infection .

【22】Commentary

【23】This patient presented with the classic triad of Sézary syndrome: erythroderma, lymphadenopathy, and atypical cells in the blood (a CD4:8 ratio of 15:1 and loss of CD7 and CD26 on 85 % of cells). Her complete blood count also demonstrated a marked eosinophilia, a not uncommon finding in patients with Sézary syndrome. She was treated with extracorporeal photopheresis, a therapy that has shown significant success in treating (but not curing) Sézary syndrome. This case also highlights the point that patients with Sézary syndrome are at risk for frequent skin infections because of their immune-compromised state and damage to the skin, which in some cases can lead to sepsis and even death.

【14】# Section 1 Differential Diagnosis of Abnormal Symptoms and Signs/34 Mania and bipolar symptoms

【15】### 34 Mania and bipolar symptoms

【16】Christopher P. Kogut and James L. Levenson

【17】Neurologic Differential Diagnosis , ed. Alan B. Ettinger and Deborah M. Weisbrot. Published by Cambridge University Press.  Cambridge University Press 2014.

【18】#### Introduction

【19】Mania is a syndrome of abnormally elevated, expansive, or irritable mood, often associated with grandiosity, a decreased need for sleep, pressured speech, racing thoughts, distractibility, an increase in goal-directed behavior or psychomotor agitation, and excessive involvement in pleasurable activities that have a high potential for negative consequences 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 \]</u>. Mania is typically experienced episodically in the course of Bipolar I disorder, though discrete episodes of mania may have a number of other causes, in which case is it often referred to in the literature as “secondary mania.” Symptoms can develop in stages, and can present with a range of severity, from mild mood lability and disrupted sleep, to gross disorganization and psychosis. The course and prognosis depend in part on the underlying cause, and may be time-limited, as in intoxication with methamphetamine, or persistent or deteriorating, as after a brain injury or neurodegenerative disease 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 \]</u>.

【20】#### Case vignette

【21】Ms. X is a 42-year-old female who was brought to the ER by her daughter for behavioral changes that began a week earlier. Initially, her daughter noticed that her mother was more irritable and argumentative, then became expansive and euphoric, talking rapidly and intensely. She had slept for periods less than an hour on 2 of the previous 4 days. She was very intent on shopping, and went to the thrift store, buying several large trash bags of clothing that she said she was coordinating into “outfits for a show.” On presentation in the ER, Ms. X was noted to be very seductively dressed, with elaborate make-up and hair. She spoke rapidly and was flirtatious with the medical student who initially interviewed her. She perseverated on multiple music projects she said she had been asked to direct by “my managers in New York.”

【22】Ms. X has a history of HIV infection and is well-known to the outpatient HIV clinic where she has been a patient on and off for many years. She has not been prescribed antiretroviral medication for HIV in the past 3 years due to limited adherence. She has a history of cocaine use, though denies any use in the last 6 months. She has been seen by a consulting psychiatrist in the clinic and was recently started on bupropion for depression, which she states she has been taking. She had never had symptoms of mania in the past. She was hospitalized with depression after an intentional overdose of medications after a cocaine binge 3 years ago. There is no family history of bipolar disorder, though she has several family members with histories of depression and substance use 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 \]</u>.

【23】Ms. X had routine labs in the ER, which demonstrated a mild leukopenia with a WBC of 3.5×109 L −1 , and normal electrolytes. Her drug screen was positive only for alcohol, with a level of 0.05%. 【15】### 34 Mania and bipolar symptoms

【16】Christopher P. Kogut and James L. Levenson

【18】#### Introduction

【19】Mania is a syndrome of abnormally elevated, expansive, or irritable mood, often associated with grandiosity, a decreased need for sleep, pressured speech, racing thoughts, distractibility, an increase in goal-directed behavior or psychomotor agitation, and excessive involvement in pleasurable activities that have a high potential for negative consequences 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 \]</u>. Mania is typically experienced episodically in the course of Bipolar I disorder, though discrete episodes of mania may have a number of other causes, in which case is it often referred to in the literature as “secondary mania.” Symptoms can develop in stages, and can present with a range of severity, from mild mood lability and disrupted sleep, to gross disorganization and psychosis. The course and prognosis depend in part on the underlying cause, and may be time-limited, as in intoxication with methamphetamine, or persistent or deteriorating, as after a brain injury or neurodegenerative disease 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 \]</u>.

【20】#### Case vignette

【21】Ms. X is a 42-year-old female who was brought to the ER by her daughter for behavioral changes that began a week earlier. Initially, her daughter noticed that her mother was more irritable and argumentative, then became expansive and euphoric, talking rapidly and intensely. She had slept for periods less than an hour on 2 of the previous 4 days. She was very intent on shopping, and went to the thrift store, buying several large trash bags of clothing that she said she was coordinating into “outfits for a show.” On presentation in the ER, Ms. X was noted to be very seductively dressed, with elaborate make-up and hair. She spoke rapidly and was flirtatious with the medical student who initially interviewed her. She perseverated on multiple music projects she said she had been asked to direct by “my managers in New York.”

【22】Ms. X has a history of HIV infection and is well-known to the outpatient HIV clinic where she has been a patient on and off for many years. She has not been prescribed antiretroviral medication for HIV in the past 3 years due to limited adherence. She has a history of cocaine use, though denies any use in the last 6 months. She has been seen by a consulting psychiatrist in the clinic and was recently started on bupropion for depression, which she states she has been taking. She had never had symptoms of mania in the past. She was hospitalized with depression after an intentional overdose of medications after a cocaine binge 3 years ago. There is no family history of bipolar disorder, though she has several family members with histories of depression and substance use 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 \]</u>.

【23】Ms. X had routine labs in the ER, which demonstrated a mild leukopenia with a WBC of 3.5×109 L −1 , and normal electrolytes. Her drug screen was positive only for alcohol, with a level of 0.05%. She was admitted to psychiatry, where additional tests were ordered. Thyroid-stimulating hormone was normal, CD4 count was 45/mm 3 , and HIV viral load was 58,000 m L −1 . Brain MRI demonstrated generalized volume loss more than expected for her age, and hyperintense periventricular lesions on T2 weighted images. Cerebrospinal fluid analysis was within normal limits.

【24】The differential diagnosis includes bipolar disorder, mania secondary to HIV infection, mania secondary to the initiation of an antidepressant, and mania secondary to stimulant use. 【1】Because of the significant risk of malignancy, strict screening regimens are crucial for patients with FAP/GS. Due to the inevitability of developing CRC, patients with FAP/GS should undergo annual sigmoidoscopy starting at age 10–15 and prophylactic colectomy is typically recommended when polyps are identified or by the end of the 2nd or 3rd decade 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 5 , 6 , 18 \]</u>. Chemoprevention with cyclooxygenase inhibitors (i.e. celecoxib) has been associated with some level of polyp regression, but is not adequate to control the cancer risk 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 24 \]</u>.

【2】Other recommended screening includes upper GI endoscopy every 1–3 years (depending on polyp burden) along with annual thyroid exam due to risk of malignancy 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 18 , 25 \]</u>. Annual abdominal ultrasounds and monitoring of serum α-fetoprotein levels during the first 5 years of life are recommended due to risk of hepatoblastoma in this age group 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 \]</u>. Ophthalmologic exam should be performed upon consideration of the diagnosis of FAP/GS to evaluate for the presence of CHRPE. Panoramic dental radiographs can detect osteomas, odontomas, and supernumerary teeth, and long-bone x-rays can be used to detect osteomas 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 \]</u>. No consensus exists for routine screening for the detection of desmoid tumors, but palpable masses or symptoms should be explored using computerized tomography 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 \]</u>.

【3】Genetic counseling is an extremely important consideration and all family members should be offered genetic testing and be evaluated for evidence of GS.

【4】29.6 Conclusion
---------------

【5】Gardner syndrome affects multiple body systems, including the skin, soft tissue, bone, gastrointestinal system, as well as other solid organs. Recognition of cutaneous signs may provide an early diagnosis and can be lifesaving with proper management.

【42】Basal cell nevus syndrome (BCNS) is an autosomal dominantly inherited condition first described in 1960 by Dr. Gorlin and Dr. Goltz 通用删除6(英):<u>\[1\]</u>. 【43】30.1 Introduction
-----------------

【44】Basal cell nevus syndrome (BCNS) is an autosomal dominantly inherited condition first described in 1960 by Dr. Gorlin and Dr. Goltz 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 \]</u>. BCNS is known by several other names including nevoid basal cell carcinoma syndrome, basal cell carcinoma nevus syndrome, Gorlin syndrome, and Gorlin-Goltz syndrome. Although BCNS demonstrates a high degree of penetrance, the diagnosis can be challenging due to its variable expressivity even within families 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 , 3 \]</u> and the age-dependent appearance of certain traits associated with this disorder. Some of the more frequent and characteristic features of BCNS include multiple basal cell carcinomas (BCCs), odontogenic keratocysts, skeletal abnormalities, palmar and/or plantar pits, calcified falx cerebri, and facial dysmorphism 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 \]</u>. Other clinical features found in association with BCNS include neoplasms such as medulloblastoma, ovarian fibroma, and cardiac fibromas 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 4 – 7 \]</u>.

【45】30.2 Background
---------------

【46】BCNS results from mutations in the PTCH1 tumor suppressor gene which is found on chromosome 9q22.3-q31 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 8 \]</u>. The product of the PTCH1 gene normally represses gene transcription in the Hedgehog signaling pathway by acting as a transmembrane receptor for the Sonic Hedgehog (SHH) ligand 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 9 \]</u>. The Hedgehog signaling pathway was first described as a developmental pathway during research on the fruit fly, Drosophila melanogaster 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 10 \]</u>. Post-developmentally in humans, the Hedgehog signaling pathway is typically only active in hair follicles and skin cells 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 11 \]</u>. The neoplasms of the syndrome require two hits to the PTCH1 gene, with a mutation in the second normal allele 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 12 \]</u>. However, some clinical features of BCNS, such as palmar pits, bifid rib, and macrocephaly, only require the inherited defective allele 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 \]</u>.

【47】Women and men appear to be equally affected by BCNS. However, the prevalence of BCNS ranges from 1/57,000 to 1/256,000 depending on the studied population 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 13 , 14 \]</u>. It should be noted that certain clinical manifestations of BCNS, mainly BCCs, are less prevalent in darker skin individuals 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 15 \]</u>.

【48】30.3 Clinical Presentation
--------------------------

【49】More than 100 different clinical features have been found in association with BCNS 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 16 \]</u>. The most frequent and characteristic features of BCNS have been listed chronologically by age of presentation.

【50】Facial Dysmorphism : Most individuals with BCNS have one or more of the following “coarse” facial features: macrocephaly, frontal bossing, broad nasal bridge, prognathism, high arched eyebrows and/or palate, and cleft lip/palate 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 4 , 17 \]</u>. Patients with BCNS sometimes have a history of being delivered by cesarean section due to macrocephaly which is the most common facial dysmorphism associated with BCNS 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 18 \]</u>.

【51】Skeletal Abnormalities : In addition to abnormal skull findings, other skeletal abnormalities typically present at birth include bifid ribs, vertebral abnormalities, Sprengel shoulder, pectus deformity, short 4th metacarpal, and syndactyly of the digits 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 7 \]</u>.

【52】Ocular Abnormalities : Other congenital abnormalities associated with BCNS include severe eye defects such as strabismus, hypertelorism, telecanthus, cataracts, glaucoma, microphthalmia, orbital cyst, and coloboma 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 6 , 14 , 17 \]</u>.

【53】Cardiac Fibromas : Less than 5 % of patients with BCNS develop cardiac fibromas which typically appear in the first year of life 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 6 \]</u>. The detection of this benign tumor qualifies as one of the minor criteria for the diagnosis. In general, cardiac fibromas are asymptomatic, but they can cause conduction defects (arrhythmias) and ventricular outflow obstruction 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 19 \]</u>.

【54】Medulloblastoma : Less than 5 % of patients with BCNS also present with medulloblastomas. Compared to sporadic medulloblastomas which usually occur between the ages of 6 and 10, medulloblastomas in association with BCNS are more common in male patients and typically present by 2 years of age 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 13 , 20 \]</u>.

【55】Odontogenic (Jaw) Keratocysts : Approximately 90 % of patients with BCNS develop multiple jaw keratocysts which occur mostly in the mandible 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 14 \]</u>. These keratocysts have been reported as early as 4 years old, but typically occur during the second and third decade of life 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 21 \]</u>. The presentation of these keratocysts ranges from asymptomatic to painless jaw swelling, tooth disruption, and rarely jaw fracture 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 22 \]</u>.

【56】BCCs : BCCs in patients with BCNS occur in more than 75 % of Caucasians  but less often in African American and Asian patients 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 15 , 23 \]</u>. BCCS in BCNS has been reported as early as 3 years of age, but the peak incidence occurs at 20 years of age 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 6 \]</u>. They typically occur in sun-exposed area. While only a small percentage are locally invasive, they are challenging to treat and surgical management is potentially disfiguring 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 17 \]</u>.

【58】Palmoplantar Pitting : Approximately 80 % of patients with BCNS develop palmoplantar pitting typically beginning in the second decade of life 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 24 \]</u> .

通用删除16(英):<u>Fig. 30.2|删除2图换行|1–2 mm depressed papules on the palms (Photo credit: Joshua A. Zeichner, M.D.)</u>

【60】Intracranial Calcification : In a study of 105 individuals with BCNS (mean age of 32.5 years), approximately 65 % of these patients had intracranial calcification, particularly of the falx cerebri 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 4 \]</u>.

【61】Ovarian Fibromas : Approximately 15–25 % of female patients with BCNS have ovarian fibroma which is often bilateral and calcified 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 4 , 6 \]</u>. Most are asymptomatic and are usually discovered incidentally, but some can undergo torsion 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 \]</u>.

【62】Lymphomesenteric Cysts : The exact incidence and age of presentation for lymphomesenteric cysts is unknown. They are also usually asymptomatic 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 23 \]</u>.

【63】30.4 Work-Up
------------

【64】The diagnosis of BCNS is typically based on the constellation of clinical manifestations 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 25 \]</u>. Depending on the age of the patient, the following criteria can be used to establish the diagnosis:

【65】*   Physical examination for facial dysmorphism 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 26 \]</u>.

【66】*   X-rays to detect skeletal abnormalities 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 7 \]</u>.

【67】*   Ophthalmologic evaluation 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 \]</u>.

【68】*   Measurement of head circumference to evaluate for macrocephaly 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 25 \]</u>.

【69】*   Echocardiography to evaluate for the presence of a cardiac fibroma 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 25 \]</u>.

【70】*   Brain MRI for the detection of a medulloblastoma 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 25 \]</u>.

【71】*   Panoramic jaw X-rays to evaluate for odontogenic keratocysts 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 27 \]</u>

【72】*   Skin examination (including biopsies of suspected lesions) for BCCs 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 25 \]</u>.

【73】*   Pelvic ultrasound examination to evaluate for ovarian fibromas in females 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 25 \]</u>.

【74】There have been no formal studies to help clarify the best combination of clinical features which most accurately leads to a diagnosis of BCNS. The diagnostic criteria for BCNS generally include either two major criteria or one major and two minor criteria. The major criteria include BCC before 20 years old or excessive numbers of BCCs, odontogenic (jaw) keratocyst before 20 years old, palmar and/or plantar pitting, calcification of the falx cerebri, medulloblastoma, and family history of BCNS. The minor criteria include rib abnormalities, other skeletal malformations, macrocephaly, cleft/lip palate, ovarian/cardiac fibroma, lymphomesenteric cysts, and ocular abnormalities 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 25 \]</u>.

【75】30.5 Treatment
--------------

【76】There is no cure for BCNS and patients are managed based on syndrome-related findings 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 \]</u>. The different clinical manifestations are treated similarly in patients without the disorder. However, surveillance guidelines for the detection of different tumors and odontogenic cysts are important; and thus, patients with BCNS need to be treated under the care of several specialists including medical geneticists, dermatologists, oral surgeons, and plastic surgeons 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 25 \]</u>. Fortunately, the life span of patient with BCNS is not significantly different from the average 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 \]</u>, but exposure to ionizing and UV radiation should be minimized to reduce the total number of BCCs 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 28 \]</u>.

【77】For the management of BCCs, a regular complete skin examination by a dermatologist every 2–4 months is recommended for patients with BCNS 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 , 25 \]</u>. Due to the increased number of BCCs typically present during a lifetime, there is a tendency to reserve surgical treatment for aggressive or invasive tumors in order to prevent disfigurement 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 , 29 \]</u>. Although the majority of BCCs are nodular in BCNS, topical application of 0.1 % tretinoin cream, 5-fluorouracil cream, and imiquimod 5 % cream is effective for treating superficial BCCs and has been used for these BCCs as well 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 , 29 , 30 \]</u>. One of the more novel therapeutic approaches for BCC involves photodynamic therapy (PDT) which is the topical application of an agent, such as 5-aminolevulinic acid (ALA, Levulan ® , DUSA Pharmaceuticals, Inc. Wilmington, MA, USA) or methyl ester form, methyl 5-aminolevulinate (MAL, Metvixia TM, Galderma, Princeton, NJ, USA) 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 31 , 32 \]</u>. Both ALA and MAL are converted to a photosensitizer protoporphyrin IX in tumor cells. MAL-PDT is unique in not only demonstrating a high efficacy in the treatment of superficial BCC; it has also been shown to be effective in the treatment of nodular BCC 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 33 \]</u>. Vismodegib, an oral Hedgehog pathway inhibitor, has also been shown to be an important option in the treatment of BCCs. However, the side effects of oral vismodegib, including muscle spasms, hair loss, altered taste sensation, weight loss, fatigue, nausea, decreased appetite, and diarrhea, may not be well tolerated in some patients 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 34 , 35 \]</u>. Additionally, a topical inhibitor of the Hedgehog pathway has shown promising results in a randomized trial for patients with BCNS 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 36 \]</u>.

【78】While great care is taken to treat BCC’s, prophylactic therapy may be used to prevent growth of new cancers. Given these patients’ high risk for continually developing BCCs, therapy to prevent them can save disfiguring treatments. Acitretin has been shown to reduce the size of clinically apparent skin cancers and may been used as chemoprevention 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 37 \]</u>. Whil

【43】30.1 Introduction
-----------------

【44】Basal cell nevus syndrome (BCNS) is an autosomal dominantly inherited condition first described in 1960 by Dr. Gorlin and Dr. Goltz 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 \]</u>. BCNS is known by several other names including nevoid basal cell carcinoma syndrome, basal cell carcinoma nevus syndrome, Gorlin syndrome, and Gorlin-Goltz syndrome. Although BCNS demonstrates a high degree of penetrance, the diagnosis can be challenging due to its variable expressivity even within families 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 , 3 \]</u> and the age-dependent appearance of certain traits associated with this disorder. Some of the more frequent and characteristic features of BCNS include multiple basal cell carcinomas (BCCs), odontogenic keratocysts, skeletal abnormalities, palmar and/or plantar pits, calcified falx cerebri, and facial dysmorphism 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 \]</u>. Other clinical features found in association with BCNS include neoplasms such as medulloblastoma, ovarian fibroma, and cardiac fibromas 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 4 – 7 \]</u>.

【45】30.2 Background
---------------

【46】BCNS results from mutations in the PTCH1 tumor suppressor gene which is found on chromosome 9q22.3-q31 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 8 \]</u>. The product of the PTCH1 gene normally represses gene transcription in the Hedgehog signaling pathway by acting as a transmembrane receptor for the Sonic Hedgehog (SHH) ligand 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 9 \]</u>. The Hedgehog signaling pathway was first described as a developmental pathway during research on the fruit fly, Drosophila melanogaster 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 10 \]</u>. Post-developmentally in humans, the Hedgehog signaling pathway is typically only active in hair follicles and skin cells 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 11 \]</u>. The neoplasms of the syndrome require two hits to the PTCH1 gene, with a mutation in the second normal allele 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 12 \]</u>. However, some clinical features of BCNS, such as palmar pits, bifid rib, and macrocephaly, only require the inherited defective allele 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 \]</u>.

【47】Women and men appear to be equally affected by BCNS. However, the prevalence of BCNS ranges from 1/57,000 to 1/256,000 depending on the studied population 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 13 , 14 \]</u>. It should be noted that certain clinical manifestations of BCNS, mainly BCCs, are less prevalent in darker skin individuals 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 15 \]</u>.

【48】30.3 Clinical Presentation
--------------------------

【49】More than 100 different clinical features have been found in association with BCNS 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 16 \]</u>. The most frequent and characteristic features of BCNS have been listed chronologically by age of presentation.

【50】Facial Dysmorphism : Most individuals with BCNS have one or more of the following “coarse” facial features: macrocephaly, frontal bossing, broad nasal bridge, prognathism, high arched eyebrows and/or palate, and cleft lip/palate 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 4 , 17 \]</u>. Patients with BCNS sometimes have a history of being delivered by cesarean section due to macrocephaly which is the most common facial dysmorphism associated with BCNS 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 18 \]</u>.

【51】Skeletal Abnormalities : In addition to abnormal skull findings, other skeletal abnormalities typically present at birth include bifid ribs, vertebral abnormalities, Sprengel shoulder, pectus deformity, short 4th metacarpal, and syndactyly of the digits 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 7 \]</u>.

【52】Ocular Abnormalities : Other congenital abnormalities associated with BCNS include severe eye defects such as strabismus, hypertelorism, telecanthus, cataracts, glaucoma, microphthalmia, orbital cyst, and coloboma 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 6 , 14 , 17 \]</u>.

【53】Cardiac Fibromas : Less than 5 % of patients with BCNS develop cardiac fibromas which typically appear in the first year of life 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 6 \]</u>. The detection of this benign tumor qualifies as one of the minor criteria for the diagnosis. In general, cardiac fibromas are asymptomatic, but they can cause conduction defects (arrhythmias) and ventricular outflow obstruction 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 19 \]</u>.

【54】Medulloblastoma : Less than 5 % of patients with BCNS also present with medulloblastomas. Compared to sporadic medulloblastomas which usually occur between the ages of 6 and 10, medulloblastomas in association with BCNS are more common in male patients and typically present by 2 years of age 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 13 , 20 \]</u>.

The presentation of these keratocysts ranges from asymptomatic to painless jaw swelling, tooth disruption, and rarely jaw fracture 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 22 \]</u>.

【63】30.4 Work-Up
------------

【64】The diagnosis of BCNS is typically based on the constellation of clinical manifestations 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 25 \]</u>. Depending on the age of the patient, the following criteria can be used to establish the diagnosis:

【65】*   Physical examination for facial dysmorphism 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 26 \]</u>.

【66】*   X-rays to detect skeletal abnormalities 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 7 \]</u>.

【67】*   Ophthalmologic evaluation 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 \]</u>.

【68】*   Measurement of head circumference to evaluate for macrocephaly 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 25 \]</u>.

【69】*   Echocardiography to evaluate for the presence of a cardiac fibroma 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 25 \]</u>.

【70】*   Brain MRI for the detection of a medulloblastoma 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 25 \]</u>.

【71】*   Panoramic jaw X-rays to evaluate for odontogenic keratocysts 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 27 \]</u>

【74】There have been no formal studies to help clarify the best combination of clinical features which most accurately leads to a diagnosis of BCNS. --------------

【76】There is no cure for BCNS and patients are managed based on syndrome-related findings 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 \]</u>. 【41】Abstract

【42】Basal cell nevus syndrome (BCNS) is an autosomal dominantly inherited condition first described in 1960 by Dr. Gorlin and Dr. Goltz 通用删除6(英):<u>\[1\]</u>. BCNS is known by several other names including nevoid basal cell carcinoma syndrome, basal cell carcinoma nevus syndrome, Gorlin syndrome, and Gorlin-Goltz syndrome. Although BCNS demonstrates a high degree of penetrance, the diagnosis can be challenging due to its variable expressivity even within families 通用删除6(英):<u>\[2, 3\]</u> and the age-dependent appearance of certain traits associated with this disorder. Some of the more frequent and characteristic features of BCNS include multiple basal cell carcinomas (BCCs), odontogenic keratocysts, skeletal abnormalities, palmar and/or plantar pits, calcified falx cerebri, and facial dysmorphism 通用删除6(英):<u>\[1\]</u>. 【43】30.1 Introduction
-----------------

【44】Basal cell nevus syndrome (BCNS) is an autosomal dominantly inherited condition first described in 1960 by Dr. Gorlin and Dr. Goltz 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 \]</u>. BCNS is known by several other names including nevoid basal cell carcinoma syndrome, basal cell carcinoma nevus syndrome, Gorlin syndrome, and Gorlin-Goltz syndrome. Although BCNS demonstrates a high degree of penetrance, the diagnosis can be challenging due to its variable expressivity even within families 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 , 3 \]</u> and the age-dependent appearance of certain traits associated with this disorder. Some of the more frequent and characteristic features of BCNS include multiple basal cell carcinomas (BCCs), odontogenic keratocysts, skeletal abnormalities, palmar and/or plantar pits, calcified falx cerebri, and facial dysmorphism 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 \]</u>. Other clinical features found in association with BCNS include neoplasms such as medulloblastoma, ovarian fibroma, and cardiac fibromas 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 4 – 7 \]</u>.

【45】30.2 Background
---------------

【46】BCNS results from mutations in the PTCH1 tumor suppressor gene which is found on chromosome 9q22.3-q31 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 8 \]</u>. The product of the PTCH1 gene normally represses gene transcription in the Hedgehog signaling pathway by acting as a transmembrane receptor for the Sonic Hedgehog (SHH) ligand 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 9 \]</u>. The Hedgehog signaling pathway was first described as a developmental pathway during research on the fruit fly, Drosophila melanogaster 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 10 \]</u>. Post-developmentally in humans, the Hedgehog signaling pathway is typically only active in hair follicles and skin cells 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 11 \]</u>. The neoplasms of the syndrome require two hits to the PTCH1 gene, with a mutation in the second normal allele 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 12 \]</u>. However, some clinical features of BCNS, such as palmar pits, bifid rib, and macrocephaly, only require the inherited defective allele 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 \]</u>.

【47】Women and men appear to be equally affected by BCNS. However, the prevalence of BCNS ranges from 1/57,000 to 1/256,000 depending on the studied population 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 13 , 14 \]</u>. It should be noted that certain clinical manifestations of BCNS, mainly BCCs, are less prevalent in darker skin individuals 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 15 \]</u>.

【48】30.3 Clinical Presentation
--------------------------

【49】More than 100 different clinical features have been found in association with BCNS 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 16 \]</u>. The most frequent and characteristic features of BCNS have been listed chronologically by age of presentation.

【50】Facial Dysmorphism : Most individuals with BCNS have one or more of the following “coarse” facial features: macrocephaly, frontal bossing, broad nasal bridge, prognathism, high arched eyebrows and/or palate, and cleft lip/palate 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 4 , 17 \]</u>. Patients with BCNS sometimes have a history of being delivered by cesarean section due to macrocephaly which is the most common facial dysmorphism associated with BCNS 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 18 \]</u>.

【51】Skeletal Abnormalities : In addition to abnormal skull findings, other skeletal abnormalities typically present at birth include bifid ribs, vertebral abnormalities, Sprengel shoulder, pectus deformity, short 4th metacarpal, and syndactyly of the digits 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 7 \]</u>.

【52】Ocular Abnormalities : Other congenital abnormalities associated with BCNS include severe eye defects such as strabismus, hypertelorism, telecanthus, cataracts, glaucoma, microphthalmia, orbital cyst, and coloboma 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 6 , 14 , 17 \]</u>.

【53】Cardiac Fibromas : Less than 5 % of patients with BCNS develop cardiac fibromas which typically appear in the first year of life 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 6 \]</u>. The detection of this benign tumor qualifies as one of the minor criteria for the diagnosis. In general, cardiac fibromas are asymptomatic, but they can cause conduction defects (arrhythmias) and ventricular outflow obstruction 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 19 \]</u>.

【54】Medulloblastoma : Less than 5 % of patients with BCNS also present with medulloblastomas. Compared to sporadic medulloblastomas which usually occur between the ages of 6 and 10, medulloblastomas in association with BCNS are more common in male patients and typically present by 2 years of age 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 13 , 20 \]</u>.

【55】Odontogenic (Jaw) Keratocysts : Approximately 90 % of patients with BCNS develop multiple jaw keratocysts which occur mostly in the mandible 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 14 \]</u>. These keratocysts have been reported as early as 4 years old, but typically occur during the second and third decade of life 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 21 \]</u>. The presentation of these keratocysts ranges from asymptomatic to painless jaw swelling, tooth disruption, and rarely jaw fracture 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 22 \]</u>.

【56】BCCs : BCCs in patients with BCNS occur in more than 75 % of Caucasians  but less often in African American and Asian patients 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 15 , 23 \]</u>. BCCS in BCNS has been reported as early as 3 years of age, but the peak incidence occurs at 20 years of age 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 6 \]</u>. They typically occur in sun-exposed area. While only a small percentage are locally invasive, they are challenging to treat and surgical management is potentially disfiguring 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 17 \]</u>.

【58】Palmoplantar Pitting : Approximately 80 % of patients with BCNS develop palmoplantar pitting typically beginning in the second decade of life 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 24 \]</u> .

通用删除16(英):<u>Fig. 30.2|删除2图换行|1–2 mm depressed papules on the palms (Photo credit: Joshua A. Zeichner, M.D.)</u>

【60】Intracranial Calcification : In a study of 105 individuals with BCNS (mean age of 32.5 years), approximately 65 % of these patients had intracranial calcification, particularly of the falx cerebri 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 4 \]</u>.

【61】Ovarian Fibromas : Approximately 15–25 % of female patients with BCNS have ovarian fibroma which is often bilateral and calcified 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 4 , 6 \]</u>. Most are asymptomatic and are usually discovered incidentally, but some can undergo torsion 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 \]</u>.

【62】Lymphomesenteric Cysts : The exact incidence and age of presentation for lymphomesenteric cysts is unknown. They are also usually asymptomatic 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 23 \]</u>.

【63】30.4 Work-Up
------------

【64】The diagnosis of BCNS is typically based on the constellation of clinical manifestations 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 25 \]</u>. Depending on the age of the patient, the following criteria can be used to establish the diagnosis:

【65】*   Physical examination for facial dysmorphism 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 26 \]</u>.

【66】*   X-rays to detect skeletal abnormalities 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 7 \]</u>.

【67】*   Ophthalmologic evaluation 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 \]</u>.

【68】*   Measurement of head circumference to evaluate for macrocephaly 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 25 \]</u>.

【69】*   Echocardiography to evaluate for the presence of a cardiac fibroma 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 25 \]</u>.

【70】*   Brain MRI for the detection of a medulloblastoma 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 25 \]</u>.

【71】*   Panoramic jaw X-rays to evaluate for odontogenic keratocysts 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 27 \]</u>

【72】*   Skin examination (including biopsies of suspected lesions) for BCCs 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 25 \]</u>.

【73】*   Pelvic ultrasound examination to evaluate for ovarian fibromas in females 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 25 \]</u>.

【74】There have been no formal studies to help clarify the best combination of clinical features which most accurately leads to a diagnosis of BCNS. The diagnostic criteria for BCNS generally include either two major criteria or one major and two minor criteria. The major criteria include BCC before 20 years old or excessive numbers of BCCs, odontogenic (jaw) keratocyst before 20 years old, palmar and/or plantar pitting, calcification of the falx cerebri, medulloblastoma, and family history of BCNS. The minor criteria include rib abnormalities, other skeletal malformations, macrocephaly, cleft/lip palate, ovarian/cardiac fibroma, lymphomesenteric cysts, and ocular abnormalities 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 25 \]</u>.

【75】30.5 Treatment
--------------

【76】There is no cure for BCNS and patients are managed based on syndrome-related findings 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 \]</u>. The different clinical manifestations are treated similarly in patients without the disorder. However, surveillance guidelines for the detection of different tumors and odontogenic cysts are important; and thus, patients with BCNS need to be treated under the care of several specialists including medical geneticists, dermatologists, oral surgeons, and plastic surgeons 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 25 \]</u>. Fortunately, the life span of patient with BCNS is not significantly different from the average 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 \]</u>, but exposure to ionizing and UV radiation should be minimized to reduce the total number of BCCs 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 28 \]</u>.

【77】For the management of BCCs, a regular complete skin examination by a dermatologist every 2–4 months is recommended for patients with BCNS 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 , 25 \]</u>. Due to the increased number of BCCs typically present during a lifetime, there is a tendency to reserve surgical treatment for aggressive or invasive tumors in order to prevent disfigurement 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 , 29 \]</u>. Although the majority of BCCs are nodular in BCNS, topical application of 0.1 % tretinoin cream, 5-fluorouracil cream, and imiquimod 5 % cream is effective for treating superficial BCCs and has been used for these BCCs as well 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 , 29 , 30 \]</u>. One of the more novel therapeutic approaches for BCC involves photodynamic therapy (PDT) which is the topical application of an agent, such as 5-aminolevulinic acid (ALA, Levulan ® , DUSA Pharmaceuticals, Inc. Wilmington, MA, USA) or methyl ester form, methyl 5-aminolevulinate (MAL, Metvixia TM, Galderma, Princeton, NJ, USA) 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 31 , 32 \]</u>. Both ALA and MAL are converted to a photosensitizer protoporphyrin IX in tumor cells. MAL-PDT is unique in not only demonstrating a high efficacy in the treatment of superficial BCC; it has also been shown to be effective in the treatment of nodular BCC 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 33 \]</u>. Vismodegib, an oral Hedgehog pathway inhibitor, has also been shown to be an important option in the treatment of BCCs. However, the side effects of oral vismodegib, including muscle spasms, hair loss, altered taste sensation, weight loss, fatigue, nausea, decreased appetite, and diarrhea, may not be well tolerated in some patients 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 34 , 35 \]</u>. Additionally, a topical inhibitor of the Hedgehog pathway has shown promising results in a randomized trial for patients with BCNS 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 36 \]</u>.

【78】While great care is taken to treat BCC’s, prophylactic therapy may be used to prevent growth of new cancers. Given these patients’ high risk for continually developing BCCs, therapy to prevent them can save disfiguring treatments. 【1】**Neurofibromais a wholly benign neoplasm， in contrast to der-matofibrosarcomaprotuberans， which is a low-grade malignant one. Rarely， dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans may metastasize， and when that happens， lymph nodes are the target. Only rarely does dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans metastasize beyond a lymph node. Solitary neurofibromas never metastasize andpractically nevergive rise to neurofibrosarcomas(malignant schwannomas). That is not the case， however， for neurofibro-mas in association with von Recklinghausen’s disease. Malignant schwanno-mas are thought to originate in about 20% of all patients with von Reckling-hausen’s disease and those develop within pre-existingneurofibromas themselves. A type of neurofibroma unique to neurofibromatosis is“plexi-form，" i.e.， within a background of conventional changes of neurofibroma in both the dermis and the subcutaneous fat are numerous structures that resemble large， distorted nerve fascicles.**

【2】**Another rare phenomenon in dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans is the development of fibrosarcoma， especially the type currently termed malig-nant fibrous histiocytoma. When those changes intervene， the biologic be-havior of the process changes， and the likelihood of metastasis， far and wide， is increased.**

【3】**In sum， because neurofibroma and dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans mayhave many histopathologic features in common， it may be difficult to differentiate them from one another in a biopsy specimen taken by punch technique. If， however， the criteria just listed are heeded， differentiation of these two neoplasms should be possible in nearly all instances.**

**ANCIENT schwannomas and malignant schwan-|删除0换行|nomas have many histopathologic features in common. Neural differentia-tion and cytologic atypia are the most important of them. Both tend to be highly cellular neoplasms comprised of diffuse proliferations of spindle cells， many of which show wavy or S-shaped nuclei， that are arranged in fascicles throughout the dermis， obliterate epithelial structures of adnexa， and extend into subcutaneous fat. Abundant mucin is present in a loose stroma constituted mostly of fibrillary collagen. Mast cells are increased in zones where mucin is abundant.**

【41】**Ancient schwannomas have the silhouette of a benign neoplasm. Those architecturalfeatures， important for distinguishing it from malignant schwannomas， are symmetry， sharp circumscription， and “top-heavydis-tribution of neoplastic cells， i.e.， the cells are disposed more densely in the upper part of the dermis than in the subcutaneous fat. Malignant schwan-nomas， in contrast， usually are asymmetric， poorly circumscribed， and“bottom-heavy”in regard to their involvement by neoplastic cells.**

【42】**The hallmark of histopathologic diagnosis of schwannoma is spindle cells in palisaded array and in intertwining fascicles (Antoni A areas) or spindle and oval cells in loose arrangement (Antoni B areas). One hypothesis holds that Antoni B areas may represent nothing more than degieneration of Antoni A areas. Ancient schwannomas， as the name denotes， are aged， 1.e.， long-standing， schwannomas， but their basic histopathologic character is the same as that of other schwannomas. In addition to nuclear atypia and degenerative changes of clumped nuclear chromatin， signs of aging of a schwannoma are fibrosis， including sclerosis， and rims of homogeneous eosinophilic material (plasma proteins))around the walls of blood vessels， extravasated erythrocytes， siderophages， and deposits of fibrin. Although some authors contend that mitoses never occur in ancient schwannomas， we have found them， albeit rarely.**

**In contrast to neurofibromas， schwannomas are uncommon cutaneous neoplasms. In 1987， in which well over 100，000 specimens were processed by the Dermatopathology Laboratory at New York University Medical Cen-ter， 351 neurofibromas were diagnosed， but only 14 schwannomas. Because schwannomas originate within nerve sheaths， they invariably are well-circumscribed and are surrounded by compressed fibrous tissue. Uncom-monly， a plexiform or multinodular pattern occurs in schwannomas， but， unlike the situation in neurofibromas， plexiform schwannoma is not an indication of associated von Recklinghausen’s disease. About 20% of schwannomas， however， occur in patients with von Recklinghausen’s dis-|删除0换行|case. Schwannomas appear as subcutaneous nodules， and in our experience occur mostly in persons between ages 20 and 83， predominantly women， the woman to man ratio being 2：1. They are slowly growing， asymptomatic， benign neoplasms. Sarcomas rarely develop within them.**

【44】**Where， then， do malignant schwannomas begin? Most seem to arise de novo， but some have been known to originate in a cerebello-pontine tumnor(acoustic neuroma)， a schwannoma that affects the eighth cranial nerve. Malignant schwannomas incline to major nerve trunks， such as the brachial and sacral plexuses， and the sciatic nerve. Although approximately 10% of patients with von Recklinghausen’s disease develop malignant schwanno-mas， usually after the disease has been present for 10 or more years， most malignant schwannomas arise in persons who do not have neurofibroma-tosis.**

【45】**Of late， a remarkable analogue of ancient schwannoma has come to our attention， namely， ancient Miescher’s nevus. Miescher’s nevus is a dis-tinctive acquired nevus that appears very commonly on the head and neck as a dome-shaped， usually symmetrical， well-circumscribed， brownish le-sion in which melanocytes of the nevus may extend in a wedge-shaped phalanx far into the deep reticular dermis and even into the subcutaneous fat. As a rule， the nuclei of melanocytes of Miescher’s nevi are small， oval， and monomorphous. Ancient Miescher’s nevi have several features in com-mon with ancient schwannoma： atypical neoplastic cells， some neoplastic cells in mitosis， thrombosed vessels， hemorrhage， siderophages， rims of homogeneous eosinophilic material around some blood vessels， and sclero-sis focally. Almost always， these decades-old nevi are wholly intradermal and， although they sometimes are asymmetrical， presumably as a conse-quence of hemorrhage and fibrosis， they can be recognized for what they are by their distinctive architectural pattern as discerned at scanning mag-nification. In brief， lesions designated“ancient，" whether schwannomas or Miescher’s nevi， are long-standing and， as a consequence， exhibit startling variations from conventional examples of them. Despite cytologic features of atypia and mitotic figures， each can be judged to be benign by virtue of a summation of findings that constitute their silhouette.**

Both the angiomatous type of Kaposi's sarcoma and those hemangiomas are characterized by crowded， widely dilated vascular spaces， and by vessels that vary in size and shape， from small to large and from round to angular. Lumina of the neoplastic vessels may contain erythrocytes. Endothelial cells lining vascular spaces occasionally may be in mitosis. Only those hemangio-mas with the features just mentioned are difficult to distinguish from Kaposi's sarcoma because， at first glance at scanning magnification， the distinctive expression of Kaposi’s sarcoma under discussion here looks like an herangioma. Most hemangiomas pose no problems in differentiation from Kaposi’s sarcoma.**

【93】**Curiously， hemangiomas that simulate Kaposi’s sarcoma may have more bizarre-shaped vessels than are present in patches and plaques of authentic Kaposi’s sarcoma. In early evolving lesions of Kaposi’s sarcoma， neoplastic vessels are jagged and tend to be situated mostly around pre-existing vascular plexuses， a phenomenon that causes the original smooth-surfaced vessels to seem to protrude into serrated neoplastic vessels in the manner of promontories. Although a type of Kaposi's sarcoma simulates an hemangioma with crowded， widely dilated， round and oval vessels， some foci of changes typical of patch and plaque lesions of the disease almost always are present， too. In contrast， blood vessels in hemangiomas that simulate Kaposi's sarcoma may have jagged and angulated outlines， but they show no foci typical of Kaposi's sarcoma such as predilection for the course of pre-existing vascular plexuses. This particular feature， along with the others listed at the outset of this chapter， allows distinction between the two vascular conditions. The angiomatous variant of Kaposi's sarcoma is relatively uncommon， but it represents a major pitfall in diagnosis because it is confused so easily histiopathologically for an hemangioma.**

【94】**Clinically， Kaposi's sarcoma presents itself first as macules that may eventuate in patches or in papules or plaques that， in turn， may become nodules and turors. The clinical and histopathologic features of individual lesions of Kaposi’s sarcoma are similar in all forms of the disease， e.g.， so-called classic (Italians and Ashkanazi Jews especially)， African， or cur-rent epidemic (drug abusers and homosexual men especially). Acquired immunodeficiency disease has been demonstrated to result from infection by human immunodeficiency virus type 1. Whether that virus also is respon-sible for lesions of Kaposi’s sarcoma is unresolved. Papillomavirus has been implicated， too. The answer is not yet known.**

【95】**Hemangiomas on the legs of young adults， usually women， may simu-late patches and plaques of Kaposi’s sarcoma， and those hemangiomas serve as contrast to the angiomatous manifestation of Kaposi's sarcoma in this chapter.**

【96】**Another mimic of Kaposi’s sarcoma is targetoid hemosiderotic heman-gioma which presents itself clinically as a single annular (target-like) lesion positioned on an arm， leg， or trunk， especially of a man. Histopathologi-cally， targetoid hemosiderotic hemangioma may span the reticular dermis and extend into the subcutaneous fat. Constituent vessels are angular and lymphangiomatous， and tend to be concentrated around eccrine units. There are fibrin thrombi， numerous extravasated erythrocytes， and patchy infiltrates of inflammatory cells. In later stages， siderophages are promi-nent. Even hyaline globules， nearly specific for Kaposi’s sarcoma， are re-puted to have been spotted in endothelial cells of targetoid hemosiderotic hemangioma. A useful feature for separation of early lesions of targetoid hemosiderotic hemangioma from early Kaposi’s sarcoma is the presence of papillary endothelial fronds， i.e.， distinctive projections into lumina， situ-ated superficially in the center of the “target.1**

【97】**For almost one hundred years following the original description of idio-pathic multiple hemorrhagic sarcoma by Kaposi in 1868， histopathologists who made that diagnosis in Caucasians could be confident that patients who bore the lesions were likely to survive. During the last two decades of the twentieth century， however， the situation has changed dramatically as a consequence of what has become an epidemic， namely， the acquired immu-nodeficiency syndrome. Now， a histopathologist who renders a diagnosis of Kaposi's sarcoma in a young or middle-aged adult must understand the implications of that diagnosis well， i.e.， the patient is likely to die of the underlying process， not of Kaposi’s sarcoma itself， in months or but a few years. In short， a diagnosis of Kaposi's sarcoma in a person compromised severely immunologically is a virtual death sentence. For that reason， it is of great importance that histopathologists do not overdiagnose certain angio-mas as Kaposi's sarcoma. If careful heed is paid to the criteria enunciated in this chapter， that error can be avoided.**

【147】PINDLE-CELL lipomas and myxoid liposarcomas are both neoplasms of lipocytes (adipocytes) that， despite their clinical and biologic differences， have many histopathologic features in common. They consist of proliferations of lipidized mesenchymal cells organized in large lobules in the subcutaneous fat. The cells are oval and spindle-shaped， ex-hibit bipolar cytoplasmic projections， often have slightly wavy， serpentine， or S-shaped nuclei， and sometimes contain small intranuclear vacuoles. Mitotic figures are present in some spindle cells. The stroma usually con-tains mucin and mast cells， as well as collagen bundles in variable quantity.

【148】Differentiation of spindle-cell lipoma from myxoid liposarcoma turns on their different patterns as appreciated at scanning magnification of a conventional microscope. The benign neoplasm is relatively symmetrical and well-circumscribed； the malignant one the reverse. Myxoid liposarco-mas are typified by a highly distinctive vascular pattern in concert with monomorphous neoplastic cells distributed diffusely. The vessels are deli-cate， and their narrow lumina are filled with erythrocytes. The vascular channels interconnect in a geometric configuration， which has been com-pared repeatedly to the appearance of chicken wire. Neoplastic cells are uniformly spindle-shaped with elongated， bi-polar tails of cytoplasm. They are separated from one another by abundant mucin， the combination creat-ing the appearance of a monolayer of cells in tissue culture.

【149】Spindle cells in spindle-cell lipoma， in contrast to those of myxoid lipo-sarcoma， are often distributed in patchy fashion， and they tend to predomi-nate in one region of the neoplasm. Neoplastic cells with plump nuclei are arranged in short fascicles， a pattern that is not seen in myxoid liposarco-mnas.

【150】The spindle cells in myxoid liposarcomas have nuclei that may be ex-ceedingly thin and strikingly uniform. Adipocytes in myxoid liposarcomas may exhibit stellate cytoplasm and consist often of immature lipoblasts with signet-ring attributes， as well as of larger pleomorphic lipoblasts. Lipo-cytes in spindle-cell lipoma are mature fat cells that may show slight pleo-morphism of nuclei.

【4】Social determinants of health (SDH) is defined by the World Health Organization as “the conditions in which people are born， grow， work， live， and age， and the wider set of forces and systems shaping the conditions of daily life”.25 Examples of SDH include economic poli-cies and systems， development agendas， social norms， social policies， and political systems.25 Although clinicians are highly encouraged to practice culturally competent delivery of health care， they must also be cognizant of the social deter-minants of health to optimize patient outcomes.

【76】Each question format has advantages and limitations. The use of open-ended questions to initiate the interview may allow the client to control the interview (Case Example2.2)， but it can also prevent a false-positive or false-negative response that would otherwise be elicited by starting with closed-ended (yes or no) questions.

【77】False responses elicited by closed-ended questions may develop from the client’s attempt to please the health care provider or to comply with what the client believes is the cor-rect response or expectation.

【78】Closed-ended questions tend to be more impersonal and may set an impersonal tone for the relationship between the client and the therapist. These questions are limited by the restrictive nature of the information received so that the cli-ent may respond only to the category in question and may omit vital， but seemingly unrelated， information.

【79】Use of the funnel sequence to obtain as much information as possible through the open-ended format first (before mov-ing on to the more restrictive but clarifying “yes”or“no"type of questions at the end) can establish an effective forum for trust between the client and the therapist.
